title: Flowers on the Hill
offer: Plant flowers on the sunny hill! When they bloom, bring three crates to Gudrun's inn: she wants the inn to smell like summer.

steps.say: Flower seeds in the earth. In two days, they bloom.
Flowers on every table! The guests smile. Here is your silver, and a cup of milk for each of you.

fact: Vikings wove flowers into wreaths and crowns for feasts and weddings.
